theory RSF
  imports Complex_Main "HOL-Library.List"
begin

type_synonym vec = "real list"
type_synonym mat = "real list"

definition vec_add :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_add v1 v2 = map2 (op +) v1 v2"

definition vec_sub :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_sub v1 v2 = map2 (op -) v1 v2"

definition vec_mul :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_mul v1 v2 = map2 (op *) v1 v2"

definition vec_div :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_div v1 v2 = map2 (op /) v1 v2"

definition vec_scale :: "real \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_scale s v = map (\<lambda>x. s * x) v"

definition clip :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "clip x l u = (if x < l then l else if x > u then u else x)"

definition vec_clip :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_clip l u v = map (\<lambda>x. clip x l u) v"

definition mat_vec_mul :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> mat \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "mat_vec_mul rows cols mat vec =
    map (\<lambda>i. sum_list (map (\<lambda>j. (mat ! (i * cols + j)) * (vec ! j)) [0..<cols])) [0..<rows]"

definition mat_transpose :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> mat \<Rightarrow> mat" where
  "mat_transpose rows cols mat =
    [ mat ! (r * cols + c). c \<leftarrow> [0..<cols], r \<leftarrow> [0..<rows] ]"

definition outer_product :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> mat" where
  "outer_product v1 v2 = [ a * b. a \<leftarrow> v1, b \<leftarrow> v2 ]"

record rsf_layer =
  dim :: nat
  s_weights :: mat
  t_weights :: mat
  s_bias :: vec
  t_bias :: vec
  clip_min :: real
  clip_max :: real

definition rsf_layer_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer" where
  "rsf_layer_init dim clip_min clip_max \<equiv> \<lparr>
    dim = dim,
    s_weights = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    t_weights = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    s_bias = replicate dim 0,
    t_bias = replicate dim 0,
    clip_min = clip_min,
    clip_max = clip_max \<rparr>"

record rsf_layer_gradients =
  s_weight_grad :: mat
  t_weight_grad :: mat
  s_bias_grad :: vec
  t_bias_grad :: vec

definition rsf_gradients_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "rsf_gradients_init dim \<equiv> \<lparr>
    s_weight_grad = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    t_weight_grad = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    s_bias_grad = replicate dim 0,
    t_bias_grad = replicate dim 0 \<rparr>"

fun rsf_layer_forward :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2 =
    (let
       d = dim L;
       s_w = s_weights L;
       s_b = s_bias L;
       t_w = t_weights L;
       t_b = t_bias L;
       l = clip_min L;
       u = clip_max L;
       
       s_out = mat_vec_mul d d s_w x2;
       s_bias_added = vec_add s_out s_b;
       s_clamped = vec_clip l u s_bias_added;
       s_exp = map exp s_clamped;
       y1 = vec_mul x1 s_exp;
       
       t_out = mat_vec_mul d d t_w y1;
       t_bias_added = vec_add t_out t_b;
       y2 = vec_add x2 t_bias_added
     in (y1, y2))"

fun rsf_layer_inverse :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2 =
    (let
       d = dim L;
       s_w = s_weights L;
       s_b = s_bias L;
       t_w = t_weights L;
       t_b = t_bias L;
       l = clip_min L;
       u = clip_max L;
       
       t_out = mat_vec_mul d d t_w y1;
       t_bias_added = vec_add t_out t_b;
       x2 = vec_sub y2 t_bias_added;
       
       s_out = mat_vec_mul d d s_w x2;
       s_bias_added = vec_add s_out s_b;
       s_clamped = vec_clip l u s_bias_added;
       s_exp = map exp s_clamped;
       x1 = vec_div y1 s_exp
     in (x1, x2))"

definition rsf_network_forward :: "rsf_layer list \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_network_forward layers x1 x2 = foldl (\<lambda>(y1, y2) L. rsf_layer_forward L y1 y2) (x1, x2) layers"

definition rsf_network_inverse :: "rsf_layer list \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_network_inverse layers y1 y2 = foldr (\<lambda>L (x1, x2). rsf_layer_inverse L x1 x2) layers (y1, y2)"

definition grad_add :: "rsf_layer_gradients \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "grad_add g1 g2 = \<lparr>
    s_weight_grad = vec_add (s_weight_grad g1) (s_weight_grad g2),
    t_weight_grad = vec_add (t_weight_grad g1) (t_weight_grad g2),
    s_bias_grad = vec_add (s_bias_grad g1) (s_bias_grad g2),
    t_bias_grad = vec_add (t_bias_grad g1) (t_bias_grad g2) \<rparr>"

fun rsf_layer_backward :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec \<times> rsf_layer_gradients)" where
  "rsf_layer_backward L y1 y2 dy1 dy2 =
    (let
       d = dim L;
       s_w = s_weights L;
       t_w = t_weights L;
       s_b = s_bias L;
       t_b = t_bias L;
       l = clip_min L;
       u = clip_max L;

       t_out = mat_vec_mul d d t_w y1;
       t_bias_added = vec_add t_out t_b;
       x2 = vec_sub y2 t_bias_added;
       
       dt_bias = dy2;
       dt_weight = outer_product dy2 y1;
       
       t_w_t = mat_transpose d d t_w;
       dy1_from_t = mat_vec_mul d d t_w_t dy2;
       dy1_total = vec_add dy1 dy1_from_t;
       
       s_out = mat_vec_mul d d s_w x2;
       s_bias_added = vec_add s_out s_b;
       s_clamped = vec_clip l u s_bias_added;
       s_exp = map exp s_clamped;
       
       dx1 = vec_mul dy1_total s_exp;
       
       ds_bias_raw = vec_mul dy1_total y1;
       
       clip_indicator = map (\<lambda>v. if v \<ge> l \<and> v \<le> u then 1 else 0) s_bias_added;
       ds_bias = vec_mul ds_bias_raw clip_indicator;
       
       ds_weight = outer_product ds_bias x2;
       
       s_w_t = mat_transpose d d s_w;
       dx2 = vec_add dy2 (mat_vec_mul d d s_w_t ds_bias)
       
     in (dx1, dx2, \<lparr>s_weight_grad = ds_weight, t_weight_grad = dt_weight, s_bias_grad = ds_bias, t_bias_grad = dt_bias\<rparr>))"

definition zero_gradients :: "rsf_layer_gradients \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "zero_gradients grads \<equiv> \<lparr>
    s_weight_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (s_weight_grad grads),
    t_weight_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (t_weight_grad grads),
    s_bias_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (s_bias_grad grads),
    t_bias_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (t_bias_grad grads) \<rparr>"

lemma vec_add_length: "length (vec_add v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_add_def)

lemma vec_sub_length: "length (vec_sub v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_sub_def)

lemma vec_mul_length: "length (vec_mul v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_mul_def)

lemma vec_div_length: "length (vec_div v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_div_def)

lemma map_exp_length: "length (map exp v) = length v"
  by simp

lemma clip_id: "\<lbrakk>l \<le> x; x \<le> u\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> clip x l u = x"
  by (simp add: clip_def)

lemma vec_clip_length: "length (vec_clip l u v) = length v"
  by (simp add: vec_clip_def)

lemma mat_vec_mul_length:
  assumes "length mat = rows * cols" "length vec = cols"
  shows "length (mat_vec_mul rows cols mat vec) =ender = rows"
  using assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)

lemma vec_div_mul_cancel:
  assumes "length v1 = length v2"
  assumes "\<forall>i < length v2. v2 ! i \<noteq> 0"
  shows "vec_div (vec_mul v1 v2) v2 = v1"
  apply (simp add: vec_div_def vec_mul_def assms)
  apply (intro nth_equalityI)
  apply (simp_all)
  apply (metis (no_types, opaque_lifting) assms(1) assms(2) length_map nth_map)
  done

lemma vec_add_sub_cancel:
  assumes "length v1 = length v2"
  shows "vec_sub (vec_add v1 v2) v2 = v1"
  apply (simp add: vec_sub_def vec_add_def assms)
  apply (intro nth_equalityI)
  apply (simp_all)
  apply (metis assms(1) length_map nth_map)
  done

theorem rsf_layer_forward_shape:
  assumes "length x1 = dim L" "length x2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (y1, y2) = rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2
         in length y1 = dim L \<and> length y2 = dim L"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  let ?s_w = "s_weights L"
  let ?t_w = "t_weights L"
  let ?s_b = "s_bias L"
  let ?t_b = "t_bias L"
  
  have s_out_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) = ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have s_bias_len: "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b) = ?d"
    by (simp add: vec_add_length assms s_out_len)
  have s_exp_len: "length (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b))) = ?d"
    using s_bias_len by (simp add: map_exp_length)
  have y1_len: "length (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b)))) = ?d"
    using assms s_exp_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)

  have t_out_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b))))) = ?d"
    using y1_len assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have t_bias_len: "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?dchem ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b))))) ?t_b) = ?d"
    by (simp add: vec_add_length t_out_len assms)
  have y2_len: "length (vec_add x2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b))))) ?t_b)) = ?d"
    using assms t_bias_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)
    
  show ?thesis using y1_len y2_len by (simp add: Let_def)
qed

theorem rsf_layer_inverse_shape:
  assumes "length y1 = dim L" "length y2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (x1, x2) = rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2
         in length x1 = dim L \<and> length x2 = dim L"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  let ?s_w = "s_weights L"
  let ?t_w = "t_weights L"
  let ?s_b = "s_bias L"
  let ?t_b = "t_bias L"
  
  have t_out_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) = ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have t_bias_len: "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b) = ?d"
    by (simp add: vec_add_length assms t_out_len)
  have x2_len: "length (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b)) = ?d"
    using assms t_bias_len by (simp add: vec_sub_length)

  have s_out_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) = ?d"
    using x2_len assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have s_bias_len: "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) ?s_b) = ?d"
    by (simp add: vec_add_length assms s_out_len)
  have s_exp_len: "length (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) ?s_b))) = ?d"
    using s_bias_len by (simp add: map_exp_length)
  have x1_len: "length (vec_div y1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) ?s_b)))) = ?d"
    using assms s_exp_len by (simp add: vec_div_length)

  show ?thesis using x1_len x2_len by (simp add: Let_def)
qed

theorem rsf_layer_invertibility:
  assumes "length x1 = dim L" "length x2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  assumes "\<forall>i < dim L. (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul (dim L) (dim L) (s_weights L) x2) (s_bias L))) ! i) \<noteq> 0"
  shows "rsf_layer_inverse L (fst (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) (snd (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) = (x1, x2)"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  let ?s_w = "s_weights L"
  let ?t_w = "t_weights L"
  let ?s_b = "s_bias L"
  let ?t_b = "t_bias L"
  let ?l = "clip_min L"
  let ?u = "clip_max L"

  let ?s_p = "vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b"
  let ?s_c = "vec_clip ?l ?u ?s_p"
  let ?s_e = "map exp ?s_c"
  let ?y1 = "vec_mul x1 ?s_e"
  
  let ?t_p = "mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w ?y1"
  let ?t_b_a = "vec_add ?t_p ?t_b"
  let ?y2 = "vec_add x2 ?t_b_a"

  have inv_y1: "rsf_layer_inverse L ?y1 ?y2 = (vec_div ?y1 ?s_e, vec_sub ?y2 ?t_b_a)"
    by (simp add: rsf_layer_inverse_def Let_def)
  
  have sub_cancel: "vec_sub ?y2 ?t_b_a = x2"
    apply (rule vec_add_sub_cancel)
    by (simp_all add: assms)
    
  have div_cancel: "vec_div ?y1 ?s_e = x1"
    apply (rule vec_div_mul_cancel)
    using assms by (simp_all add: length_map map_exp_length vec_mul_length)

  show ?thesis
    apply (simp add: rsf_layer_forward_def Let_def inv_y1)
    using sub_cancel div_cancel by simp
qed

theorem rsf_network_forward_shape:
  assumes "length x1 = dim (hd layers)" "length x2 = dim (hd layers)" "layers \<noteq> []"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. dim L = dim (hd layers)"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L \<and> length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_bias L) = dim L \<and> length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (y1, y2) = rsf_network_forward layers x1 x2
         in length y1 = dim (hd layers) \<and> length y2 = dim (hd layers)"
  using assms
proof (induction layers arbitrary: x1 x2)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons L ls)
  then have prems: "length x1 = dim L" "length x2 = dim L"
                 "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
                 "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
    by auto
  have "length (fst (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) = dim L \<and> length (snd (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) = dim L"
    using prems by (simp add: rsf_layer_forward_shape)
  then have IH: "length (fst (rsf_network_forward ls (fst (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) (snd (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)))) = dim (hd ls) \<and> 
                 length (snd (rsf_network_forward ls (fst (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) (snd (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)))) = dim (hd ls)"
    using Cons by auto
  show ?case
    apply (simp add: rsf_network_forward_def Let_def)
    using IH Cons by auto
qed

theorem rsf_network_inverse_shape:
  assumes "length y1 = dim (hd layers)" "length y2 = dim (hd layers)" "layers \<noteq> []"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. dim L = dim (hd layers)"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L \<and> length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_bias L) = dim L \<and> length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (x1, x2) = rsf_network_inverse layers y1 y2
         in length x1 = dim (hd layers) \<and> length x2 = dim (hd layers)"
  using assms
proof (induction layers arbitrary: y1 y2 rule: rev_induct)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (snoc L ls)
  then have prems: "length y1 = dim L" "length y2 = dim L"
                 "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
                 "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
    by auto
  have inv_shape: "length (fst (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)) = dim L \<and> length (snd (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)) = dim L"
    using prems by (simp add: rsf_layer_inverse_shape)
  have IH: "length (fst (rsf_network_inverse ls (fst (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)) (snd (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)))) = dim (hd ls) \<and>
            length (snd (rsf_network_inverse ls (fst (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)) (snd (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)))) = dim (hd ls)"
    using snoc inv_shape by auto
  show ?case
    apply (simp add: rsf_network_inverse_def Let_def)
    using IH snoc by auto
qed

theorem rsf_layer_backward_shape:
  assumes "length y1 = dim L" "length y2 = dim L"
  assumes "length dy1 = dim L" "length dy2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (dx1, dx2, grads) = rsf_layer_backward L y1 y2 dy1 dy2
         in length dx1 = dim L \<and> length dx2 = dim L \<and>
            length (s_weight_grad grads) = dim L * dim L \<and>
            length (t_weight_grad grads) = dim L * dim L \<and>
            length (s_bias_grad grads) = dim L \<and>
            length (t_bias_grad grads) = dim L"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  let ?s_w = "s_weights L"
  let ?t_w = "t_weights L"
  let ?t_b = "t_bias L"

  have x2_len: "length (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b)) = ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: vec_sub_length vec_add_length mat_vec_mul_length)
    
  have s_w_t_len: "length (mat_transpose ?d ?d ?s_w) = ?d * ?d"
    by (simp add: mat_transpose_def)
  have t_w_t_len: "length (mat_transpose ?d ?d ?t_w) = ?d * ?d"
    by (simp add: mat_transpose_def)
    
  have dy1_from_t_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (mat_transpose ?d ?d ?t_w) dy2) = ?d"
    using assms t_w_t_len by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have dy1_total_len: "length (vec_add dy1 (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (mat_transpose ?d ?d ?t_w) dy2)) = ?d"
    using assms dy1_from_t_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)
    
  let ?s_b = "vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) (s_bias L)"
  have s_b_len: "length ?s_b = ?d"
    using assms x2_len by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length vec_add_length)
    
  have s_exp_len: "length (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) ?s_b)) = ?d"
    using s_b_len by (simp add: map_exp_length)
    
  have dx1_len: "length (vec_mul dy1_total (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) ?s_b))) = ?d"
    using assms dy1_total_len s_exp_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)
    
  have ds_bias_raw_len: "length (vec_mul dy1_total y1) = ?d"
    using assms dy1_total_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)
  have ds_bias_len: "length (vec_mul (vec_mul dy1_total y1) (map (\<lambda>v. if v \<ge> clip_min L \<and> v \<le> clip_max L then 1 else 0) ?s_b)) = ?d"
    using ds_bias_raw_len s_b_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)
  
  have ds_w_len: "length (outer_product (vec_mul (vec_mul dy1_total y1) (map (\<lambda>v. if v \<ge> clip_min L \<and> v \<le> clip_max L then 1 else 0) ?s_b)) (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) = ?d * ?d"
    using ds_bias_len x2_len by (simp add: outer_product_def)
    
  have dt_w_len: "length (outer_product dy2 y1) = ?d * ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: outer_product_def)

  show ?thesis
    by (simp add: rsf_layer_backward_def Let_def dx1_len dx2_len ds_w_len dt_w_len ds_bias_len assms)

theory RSF
  imports Complex_Main "HOL-Library.List"
begin

type_synonym vec = "real list"
type_synonym mat = "real list"

definition vec_add :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_add v1 v2 = map2 (op +) v1 v2"

definition vec_sub :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_sub v1 v2 = map2 (op -) v1 v2"

definition vec_mul :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_mul v1 v2 = map2 (op *) v1 v2"

definition vec_div :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_div v1 v2 = map2 (op /) v1 v2"

definition vec_scale :: "real \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_scale s v = map (\<lambda>x. s * x) v"

definition clip :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "clip x l u = (if x < l then l else if x > u then u else x)"

definition vec_clip :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_clip l u v = map (\<lambda>x. clip x l u) v"

definition mat_vec_mul :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> mat \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "mat_vec_mul rows cols mat vec =
    map (\<lambda>i. sum_list (map (\<lambda>j. (mat ! (i * cols + j)) * (vec ! j)) [0..<cols])) [0..<rows]"

definition mat_transpose :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> mat \<Rightarrow> mat" where
  "mat_transpose rows cols mat =
    [ mat ! (r * cols + c). c \<leftarrow> [0..<cols], r \<leftarrow> [0..<rows] ]"

definition outer_product :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> mat" where
  "outer_product v1 v2 = [ a * b. a \<leftarrow> v1, b \<leftarrow> v2 ]"

record rsf_layer =
  dim :: nat
  s_weights :: mat
  t_weights :: mat
  s_bias :: vec
  t_bias :: vec
  clip_min :: real
  clip_max :: real

definition rsf_layer_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer" where
  "rsf_layer_init dim clip_min clip_max \<equiv> \<lparr>
    dim = dim,
    s_weights = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    t_weights = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    s_bias = replicate dim 0,
    t_bias = replicate dim 0,
    clip_min = clip_min,
    clip_max = clip_max \<rparr>"

record rsf_layer_gradients =
  s_weight_grad :: mat
  t_weight_grad :: mat
  s_bias_grad :: vec
  t_bias_grad :: vec

definition rsf_gradients_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "rsf_gradients_init dim \<equiv> \<lparr>
    s_weight_grad = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    t_weight_grad = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    s_bias_grad = replicate dim 0,
    t_bias_grad = replicate dim 0 \<rparr>"

fun rsf_layer_forward :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2 =
    (let
       d = dim L;
       s_w = s_weights L;
       s_b = s_bias L;
       t_w = t_weights L;
       t_b = t_bias L;
       l = clip_min L;
       u = clip_max L;
       
       s_out = mat_vec_mul d d s_w x2;
       s_bias_added = vec_add s_out s_b;
       s_clamped = vec_clip l u s_bias_added;
       s_exp = map exp s_clamped;
       y1 = vec_mul x1 s_exp;
       
       t_out = mat_vec_mul d d t_w y1;
       t_bias_added = vec_add t_out t_b;
       y2 = vec_add x2 t_bias_added
     in (y1, y2))"

fun rsf_layer_inverse :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2 =
    (let
       d = dim L;
       s_w = s_weights L;
       s_b = s_bias L;
       t_w = t_weights L;
       t_b = t_bias L;
       l = clip_min L;
       u = clip_max L;
       
       t_out = mat_vec_mul d d t_w y1;
       t_bias_added = vec_add t_out t_b;
       x2 = vec_sub y2 t_bias_added;
       
       s_out = mat_vec_mul d d s_w x2;
       s_bias_added = vec_add s_out s_b;
       s_clamped = vec_clip l u s_bias_added;
       s_exp = map exp s_clamped;
       x1 = vec_div y1 s_exp
     in (x1, x2))"

definition rsf_network_forward :: "rsf_layer list \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_network_forward layers x1 x2 = foldl (\<lambda>(y1, y2) L. rsf_layer_forward L y1 y2) (x1, x2) layers"

definition rsf_network_inverse :: "rsf_layer list \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_network_inverse layers y1 y2 = foldr (\<lambda>L (x1, x2). rsf_layer_inverse L x1 x2) layers (y1, y2)"

definition grad_add :: "rsf_layer_gradients \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "grad_add g1 g2 = \<lparr>
    s_weight_grad = vec_add (s_weight_grad g1) (s_weight_grad g2),
    t_weight_grad = vec_add (t_weight_grad g1) (t_weight_grad g2),
    s_bias_grad = vec_add (s_bias_grad g1) (s_bias_grad g2),
    t_bias_grad = vec_add (t_bias_grad g1) (t_bias_grad g2) \<rparr>"

fun rsf_layer_backward :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec \<times> rsf_layer_gradients)" where
  "rsf_layer_backward L y1 y2 dy1 dy2 =
    (let
       d = dim L;
       s_w = s_weights L;
       t_w = t_weights L;
       s_b = s_bias L;
       t_b = t_bias L;
       l = clip_min L;
       u = clip_max L;

       t_out = mat_vec_mul d d t_w y1;
       t_bias_added = vec_add t_out t_b;
       x2 = vec_sub y2 t_bias_added;
       
       dt_bias = dy2;
       dt_weight = outer_product dy2 y1;
       
       t_w_t = mat_transpose d d t_w;
       dy1_from_t = mat_vec_mul d d t_w_t dy2;
       dy1_total = vec_add dy1 dy1_from_t;
       
       s_out = mat_vec_mul d d s_w x2;
       s_bias_added = vec_add s_out s_b;
       s_clamped = vec_clip l u s_bias_added;
       s_exp = map exp s_clamped;
       
       dx1 = vec_mul dy1_total s_exp;
       
       ds_bias_raw = vec_mul dy1_total y1;
       
       clip_indicator = map (\<lambda>v. if v \<ge> l \<and> v \<le> u then 1 else 0) s_bias_added;
       ds_bias = vec_mul ds_bias_raw clip_indicator;
       
       ds_weight = outer_product ds_bias x2;
       
       s_w_t = mat_transpose d d s_w;
       dx2 = vec_add dy2 (mat_vec_mul d d s_w_t ds_bias)
       
     in (dx1, dx2, \<lparr>s_weight_grad = ds_weight, t_weight_grad = dt_weight, s_bias_grad = ds_bias, t_bias_grad = dt_bias\<rparr>))"

definition zero_gradients :: "rsf_layer_gradients \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "zero_gradients grads \<equiv> \<lparr>
    s_weight_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (s_weight_grad grads),
    t_weight_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (t_weight_grad grads),
    s_bias_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (s_bias_grad grads),
    t_bias_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (t_bias_grad grads) \<rparr>"

lemma vec_add_length: "length (vec_add v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_add_def)

lemma vec_sub_length: "length (vec_sub v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_sub_def)

lemma vec_mul_length: "length (vec_mul v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_mul_def)

lemma vec_div_length: "length (vec_div v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_div_def)

lemma map_exp_length: "length (map exp v) = length v"
  by simp

lemma clip_id: "\<lbrakk>l \<le> x; x \<le> u\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> clip x l u = x"
  by (simp add: clip_def)

lemma vec_clip_length: "length (vec_clip l u v) = length v"
  by (simp add: vec_clip_def)

lemma mat_vec_mul_length:
  assumes "length mat = rows * cols" "length vec = cols"
  shows "length (mat_vec_mul rows cols mat vec) =ender = rows"
  using assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)

lemma vec_div_mul_cancel:
  assumes "length v1 = length v2"
  assumes "\<forall>i < length v2. v2 ! i \<noteq> 0"
  shows "vec_div (vec_mul v1 v2) v2 = v1"
  apply (simp add: vec_div_def vec_mul_def assms)
  apply (intro nth_equalityI)
  apply (simp_all)
  apply (metis (no_types, opaque_lifting) assms(1) assms(2) length_map nth_map)
  done

lemma vec_add_sub_cancel:
  assumes "length v1 = length v2"
  shows "vec_sub (vec_add v1 v2) v2 = v1"
  apply (simp add: vec_sub_def vec_add_def assms)
  apply (intro nth_equalityI)
  apply (simp_all)
  apply (metis assms(1) length_map nth_map)
  done

theorem rsf_layer_forward_shape:
  assumes "length x1 = dim L" "length x2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (y1, y2) = rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2
         in length y1 = dim L \<and> length y2 = dim L"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  let ?s_w = "s_weights L"
  let ?t_w = "t_weights L"
  let ?s_b = "s_bias L"
  let ?t_b = "t_bias L"
  
  have s_out_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) = ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have s_bias_len: "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b) = ?d"
    by (simp add: vec_add_length assms s_out_len)
  have s_exp_len: "length (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b))) = ?d"
    using s_bias_len by (simp add: map_exp_length)
  have y1_len: "length (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b)))) = ?d"
    using assms s_exp_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)

  have t_out_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b))))) = ?d"
    using y1_len assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have t_bias_len: "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?dchem ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b))))) ?t_b) = ?d"
    by (simp add: vec_add_length t_out_len assms)
  have y2_len: "length (vec_add x2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b))))) ?t_b)) = ?d"
    using assms t_bias_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)
    
  show ?thesis using y1_len y2_len by (simp add: Let_def)
qed

theorem rsf_layer_inverse_shape:
  assumes "length y1 = dim L" "length y2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (x1, x2) = rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2
         in length x1 = dim L \<and> length x2 = dim L"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  let ?s_w = "s_weights L"
  let ?t_w = "t_weights L"
  let ?s_b = "s_bias L"
  let ?t_b = "t_bias L"
  
  have t_out_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) = ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have t_bias_len: "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b) = ?d"
    by (simp add: vec_add_length assms t_out_len)
  have x2_len: "length (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b)) = ?d"
    using assms t_bias_len by (simp add: vec_sub_length)

  have s_out_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) = ?d"
    using x2_len assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have s_bias_len: "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) ?s_b) = ?d"
    by (simp add: vec_add_length assms s_out_len)
  have s_exp_len: "length (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) ?s_b))) = ?d"
    using s_bias_len by (simp add: map_exp_length)
  have x1_len: "length (vec_div y1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) ?s_b)))) = ?d"
    using assms s_exp_len by (simp add: vec_div_length)

  show ?thesis using x1_len x2_len by (simp add: Let_def)
qed

theorem rsf_layer_invertibility:
  assumes "length x1 = dim L" "length x2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  assumes "\<forall>i < dim L. (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) (vec_add (mat_vec_mul (dim L) (dim L) (s_weights L) x2) (s_bias L))) ! i) \<noteq> 0"
  shows "rsf_layer_inverse L (fst (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) (snd (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) = (x1, x2)"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  let ?s_w = "s_weights L"
  let ?t_w = "t_weights L"
  let ?s_b = "s_bias L"
  let ?t_b = "t_bias L"
  let ?l = "clip_min L"
  let ?u = "clip_max L"

  let ?s_p = "vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b"
  let ?s_c = "vec_clip ?l ?u ?s_p"
  let ?s_e = "map exp ?s_c"
  let ?y1 = "vec_mul x1 ?s_e"
  
  let ?t_p = "mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w ?y1"
  let ?t_b_a = "vec_add ?t_p ?t_b"
  let ?y2 = "vec_add x2 ?t_b_a"

  have inv_y1: "rsf_layer_inverse L ?y1 ?y2 = (vec_div ?y1 ?s_e, vec_sub ?y2 ?t_b_a)"
    by (simp add: rsf_layer_inverse_def Let_def)
  
  have sub_cancel: "vec_sub ?y2 ?t_b_a = x2"
    apply (rule vec_add_sub_cancel)
    by (simp_all add: assms)
    
  have div_cancel: "vec_div ?y1 ?s_e = x1"
    apply (rule vec_div_mul_cancel)
    using assms by (simp_all add: length_map map_exp_length vec_mul_length)

  show ?thesis
    apply (simp add: rsf_layer_forward_def Let_def inv_y1)
    using sub_cancel div_cancel by simp
qed

theorem rsf_network_forward_shape:
  assumes "length x1 = dim (hd layers)" "length x2 = dim (hd layers)" "layers \<noteq> []"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. dim L = dim (hd layers)"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L \<and> length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_bias L) = dim L \<and> length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (y1, y2) = rsf_network_forward layers x1 x2
         in length y1 = dim (hd layers) \<and> length y2 = dim (hd layers)"
  using assms
proof (induction layers arbitrary: x1 x2)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons L ls)
  then have prems: "length x1 = dim L" "length x2 = dim L"
                 "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
                 "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
    by auto
  have "length (fst (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) = dim L \<and> length (snd (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) = dim L"
    using prems by (simp add: rsf_layer_forward_shape)
  then have IH: "length (fst (rsf_network_forward ls (fst (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) (snd (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)))) = dim (hd ls) \<and> 
                 length (snd (rsf_network_forward ls (fst (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) (snd (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)))) = dim (hd ls)"
    using Cons by auto
  show ?case
    apply (simp add: rsf_network_forward_def Let_def)
    using IH Cons by auto
qed

theorem rsf_network_inverse_shape:
  assumes "length y1 = dim (hd layers)" "length y2 = dim (hd layers)" "layers \<noteq> []"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. dim L = dim (hd layers)"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L \<and> length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_bias L) = dim L \<and> length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (x1, x2) = rsf_network_inverse layers y1 y2
         in length x1 = dim (hd layers) \<and> length x2 = dim (hd layers)"
  using assms
proof (induction layers arbitrary: y1 y2 rule: rev_induct)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (snoc L ls)
  then have prems: "length y1 = dim L" "length y2 = dim L"
                 "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
                 "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
    by auto
  have inv_shape: "length (fst (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)) = dim L \<and> length (snd (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)) = dim L"
    using prems by (simp add: rsf_layer_inverse_shape)
  have IH: "length (fst (rsf_network_inverse ls (fst (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)) (snd (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)))) = dim (hd ls) \<and>
            length (snd (rsf_network_inverse ls (fst (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)) (snd (rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2)))) = dim (hd ls)"
    using snoc inv_shape by auto
  show ?case
    apply (simp add: rsf_network_inverse_def Let_def)
    using IH snoc by auto
qed

theorem rsf_layer_backward_shape:
  assumes "length y1 = dim L" "length y2 = dim L"
  assumes "length dy1 = dim L" "length dy2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (dx1, dx2, grads) = rsf_layer_backward L y1 y2 dy1 dy2
         in length dx1 = dim L \<and> length dx2 = dim L \<and>
            length (s_weight_grad grads) = dim L * dim L \<and>
            length (t_weight_grad grads) = dim L * dim L \<and>
            length (s_bias_grad grads) = dim L \<and>
            length (t_bias_grad grads) = dim L"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  let ?s_w = "s_weights L"
  let ?t_w = "t_weights L"
  let ?t_b = "t_bias L"

  have x2_len: "length (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b)) = ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: vec_sub_length vec_add_length mat_vec_mul_length)
    
  have s_w_t_len: "length (mat_transpose ?d ?d ?s_w) = ?d * ?d"
    by (simp add: mat_transpose_def)
  have t_w_t_len: "length (mat_transpose ?d ?d ?t_w) = ?d * ?d"
    by (simp add: mat_transpose_def)
    
  have dy1_from_t_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (mat_transpose ?d ?d ?t_w) dy2) = ?d"
    using assms t_w_t_len by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have dy1_total_len: "length (vec_add dy1 (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (mat_transpose ?d ?d ?t_w) dy2)) = ?d"
    using assms dy1_from_t_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)
    
  let ?s_b = "vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) (s_bias L)"
  have s_b_len: "length ?s_b = ?d"
    using assms x2_len by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length vec_add_length)
    
  have s_exp_len: "length (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) ?s_b)) = ?d"
    using s_b_len by (simp add: map_exp_length)
    
  have dx1_len: "length (vec_mul dy1_total (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) ?s_b))) = ?d"
    using assms dy1_total_len s_exp_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)
    
  have ds_bias_raw_len: "length (vec_mul dy1_total y1) = ?d"
    using assms dy1_total_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)
  have ds_bias_len: "length (vec_mul (vec_mul dy1_total y1) (map (\<lambda>v. if v \<ge> clip_min L \<and> v \<le> clip_max L then 1 else 0) ?s_b)) = ?d"
    using ds_bias_raw_len s_b_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)
  
  have ds_w_len: "length (outer_product (vec_mul (vec_mul dy1_total y1) (map (\<lambda>v. if v \<ge> clip_min L \<and> v \<le> clip_max L then 1 else 0) ?s_b)) (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w y1) ?t_b))) = ?d * ?d"
    using ds_bias_len x2_len by (simp add: outer_product_def)
    
  have dt_w_len: "length (outer_product dy2 y1) = ?d * ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: outer_product_def)
    
  have dx2_len: "length (vec_add dy2 (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (mat_transpose ?d ?d ?s_w) (vec_mul (vec_mul dy1_total y1) (map (\<lambda>v. if v \<ge> clip_min L \<and> v \<le> clip_max L then 1 else 0) ?s_b)))) = ?d"
    using assms s_w_t_len ds_bias_len by (simp add: vec_add_length mat_vec_mul_length)
    
  show ?thesis
    by (simp add: rsf_layer_backward_def Let_def dx1_len dx2_len ds_w_len dt_w_len ds_bias_len assms)
qed

theorem zero_gradients_all_zero:
  shows "\<forall>i < length (s_weight_grad (zero_gradients g)). s_weight_grad (zero_gradients g) ! i = 0 \<and>
         \<forall>i < length (t_weight_grad (zero_gradients g)). t_weight_grad (zero_gradients g) ! i = 0 \<and>
         \<forall>i < length (s_bias_grad (zero_gradients g)). s_bias_grad (zero_gradients g) ! i = 0 \<and>
         \<forall>i < length (t_bias_grad (zero_gradients g)). t_bias_grad (zero_gradients g) ! i = 0"
  by (simp add: zero_gradients_def)

end

A mellékelt Isabelle/HOL theory jelen formájában inkább egy **vázlat**, nem “kész” formális verifikáció: több helyen valószínűleg nem is fog lefordulni, és néhány bizonyítás körkörös vagy rossz hivatkozásokat használ. Ha a célod az, hogy ez ténylegesen géppel ellenőrzött bizonyítás legyen, néhány definíciós és modelllezési döntést is át kell alakítani.

## Miért nem “valós” még
- Konkrét elgépelések/szintaxishibák vannak a szövegben (pl. a `mat_vec_mul_length` lemma állításában a `=ender = rows` rész biztosan hibás, illetve később is látszik egy “?dchem” jellegű törés), ami megakasztja a fordítást már a bizonyítások előtt.
- A `mat_vec_mul_length` lemmát saját magával próbálod bizonyítani: `by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)`, ez körkörös és nem fog működni.
- Több helyen `_def`-et hívsz olyan dolgokra, amiket `fun`-nal definiáltál (pl. `rsf_layer_inverse_def`, `rsf_layer_forward_def`); `fun` tipikusan `.simps` szabályokat generál, nem “definition” jellegű `_def` lemmát, ezért a bizonyítási lépések rossz fogódzót használnak.[1][2]

## Modelllezési buktatók (még ha le is fordul)
- A `vec_add/vec_sub/...` mind `map2`-re épül, ami eltérő hossz esetén “levág” a rövidebbig, tehát az alakhelyesség (shape) itt nem automatikus, hanem nagyon erős hossz-invariánsokra épül.
- Az indexelés `(!)`-tel listákon logikailag totális, de tartományon kívül “nem meghatározott” értéket ad (klasszikus Isabelle-minta: totális, de specifikáció szempontjából “undefined” lehet), ezért minden lényegi állításhoz expliciten kell a megfelelő `length`/index-biztonság feltétel.[2]
- Emiatt az invertibilitás/korrektség bizonyítások csak akkor lesznek “valódiak”, ha vagy (a) bizonyítod az összes indexelés tartományon belüliségét, vagy (b) olyan típust/absztrakciót használsz, ami eleve kizárja a rossz dimenziókat.

## Minimális javítások, hogy összeálljon
1) Javítsd a `mat_vec_mul_length` lemmát úgy, hogy ne önmagára hivatkozzon, és a jobb oldal helyes legyen:
```isabelle
lemma mat_vec_mul_length:
  shows "length (mat_vec_mul rows cols mat vec) = rows"
  by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_def)
```
Ez a definícióból azonnal kijön, mert `mat_vec_mul` egy `map ... [0..<rows]`, aminek hossza `rows`.

2) A `fun`-nal definiált függvényeknél `_def` helyett használd a szimplifikációs szabályokat:
- `rsf_layer_forward.simps`
- `rsf_layer_inverse.simps`
Példa jelleggel:
```isabelle
by (simp add: Let_def)
```
általában elég, mert a `fun` egyenletei simp-szabályként elérhetők.[1][2]

3) A listakomprehenzió szintaxisod alapvetően jó irány (pl. `outer_product`), de tartsd észben, hogy Isabelle-ben a listakomprehenzió alakja `[(kifejezés). kvalifikátorok...]`, pl. `[e. x ← xs, y ← ys]`. (A te kódod ezt a formát használja, csak érdemes erre ráállni fejben, amikor hibát keresel.)[3]

## Mitől lesz “tényleg” formális verifikáció
- A legnagyobb minőségi ugrás: ne “nyers” `real list`-eket használj vektorként/mátrixként, hanem dimenziót kódoló típust vagy lokálét/invariánst (pl. `locale` dimenzió-feltételekkel), így a shape-bizonyítások és az indexbiztonság nem lesz minden lemma feltételeinek fele.
- Ha maradsz listáknál, akkor célszerű az alapműveleteket “biztonságosabbra” venni: pl. `vec_add` csak azonos hosszra legyen definiálva (opció-típus, vagy precondition + lemma-csomag), különben a `map2` miatti “csendes vágás” megnehezíti, hogy a bizonyítás tényleg azt jelentse, amit matematikailag gondolsz.
- Az invertibilitásnál az `exp`-re tett “nem nulla” feltétel valós számokon felesleges (az `exp x` mindig pozitív), így ezt a részt elvileg lehet egyszerűsíteni; a nehézség inkább a hossz/index invariánsok korrekt végigvitele lesz.

Mit szeretnél pontosan: azt, hogy ez a theory *leforduljon* (azaz konkrét hibajavítás), vagy azt, hogy az “invertibilitás” állításaid valóban erős, dimenzióbiztos specifikációt jelentsenek (áttervezés típusszinten)?
